title: Normalize Reasoning Mindmap Plugin to Consistency Contract
description: Mechanical Wave-2 normalization pass on reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs/lib.rs against the repo Consistency Contract: rename WiresPlayApp -> ReasoningWiresPlayApp (C1), unwrap the single-app crate's app_wires mod to flat (C4), rename AppFactory/Bundle regions to Manifest and fix region formatting/order (C2/C3), adopt framework SDK PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids) and Terminology (app_labels!/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) primitives in place of local hand-rolled copies (C5), adopt testkit helpers for the generic undo-redo/convergence/idempotency test bodies (C5), verify resource_kind declaration. Do NOT touch the puzzle_2d app-to-app coupling (C6, reserved for a separate agent).
summary:
Mechanical Wave-2 consistency-contract pass on reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs/lib.rs (single file, no other files under reasoning/mindmap needed changes). C1: renamed app struct WiresPlayApp -> ReasoningWiresPlayApp (app id "reasoning-wires-play" stays unchanged); zero residue confirmed by repo-wide grep. C4: unwrapped the single-app `pub mod app_wires { ... }` wrapper to flat top-level code (imports hoisted, mod closing brace removed). C2/C3: renamed the old "AppFactory" region to "Manifest" and merged the old separate "Bundle" region (register_reasoning_mindmap_exports + semio_plugin! macro) into that same single Manifest region per "exactly one Manifest region" (matches the pattern already used by dag/layout/note plugins); split the old monolithic "Runtime" region into "Types" (WiresDragState/WiresPlayRuntime) and folded its helper fns plus render_canvas's relationship_edge_layers/force_layout_board/node_position into "DocumentHelpers"; consolidated DocumentPanel/CataloguePanel/InspectorPanel into one "Panels" region and renamed "Canvas" to "Render"; renamed "WiresPlayApp" region to "ReasoningWiresPlayApp"; renamed "Tests" region to "🧪️Tests"; reordered top-to-bottom into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests sequence. C5 PanelKit: deleted the local tree_item_with_action duplicate (now imports the SDK one); rewrote render_document_panel/render_catalogue_panel on semio_framework_plugin::PanelTreeBuilder (section_or_placeholder/item_id/selected/selection_change/build), replacing hand-rolled UiTreeNode/UiTreeSectionNode construction and empty-placeholder boilerplate; kept mindmap's local `selection_ids` wrapper (now a thin fallback over the SDK's `selection_ids` core, adding the singular "id"-key fallback) per the SDK doc's explicit note that mindmap is one of the apps meant to keep this wrapper. C5 Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled WiresLabels struct + EN/DE consts + resolver fn with the `app_labels!` macro (implements LocaleLabels), resolved via `resolve_labels::<WiresLabels>()`; replaced the hand-rolled wires_action_labels (id,en,de)-map builder body with `localized_label_map`; replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct-literal in `app_labels()` with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (.window_kind_label/.mode_label/.action_labels/.example_labels) - dropped the redundant `.utility_labels(HashMap::new())` since that field already defaults empty and no such builder-method call was needed. C5 Testkit: replaced local meta()/new_app() with semio_framework_plugin::testkit::meta/new_app; rewrote the undo/redo test body and the ingest-idempotency test body on testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_ingest_idempotent (same probes/actions, generic control flow now shared); left the two-instance-convergence test fully untouched/manual because it seeds a custom base document (node-1/node-2) before diverging, which is a different shape than testkit::assert_two_instances_converge's from-Default-app convergence. C6: left the puzzle_2d::Puzzle2dExtension import and PUZZLE2D_FIXTURE_SCHEMA app-to-app coupling completely untouched, as instructed (reserved for a separate agent). Resource kind: the crate had no `.resource_kind(...)` at all (a gap in the prior Wave-1 pass); added one following the graph.dag/graph.trinity precedent (id "graph.wires", dimension "graph", component_kind "wires", media_capability MeshOnly) - flagging this for Wave-4 audit since it's a new addition, not a verification of pre-existing work as the brief assumed.

VERIFIED: exhaustive manual read-through of the full rewritten file end-to-end; repo-wide grep confirms zero residual "WiresPlayApp"/"app_wires" outside the new "ReasoningWiresPlayApp" name; grep confirms all region markers use the exact "//#region 🔖️Name" / "//#endregion 🔖️Name" format (no stray "// #region" spacing) and the canonical order; brace-balance check (Python paren/brace counter) passes; cross-referenced every SDK symbol used (tree_item_with_action, PanelTreeBuilder + its section_or_placeholder/item_id/selected/selection_change/build, selection_ids, app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/is_de_locale/localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt methods, testkit::meta/new_app/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_ingest_idempotent, ResourceKindSpec/OsMediaCapability) against their real definitions/signatures in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs and framework/core/rs/lib.rs (grep + Read), not guessed; `rustfmt --check` run on the touched file - it reports the same class/magnitude of line-width-reflow diffs (33 hunks) as both the pre-edit backup (35 hunks) and the already-normalized dag/plugin crate (44 hunks), i.e. this repo does not keep files rustfmt-clean at its 250-col config and my edit is not a regression.

SKIPPED (per verification policy - shared build-lock contention from 100+ concurrent sessions): a full `cargo check -p reasoning-mindmap-plugin --lib --tests` was started in the background but produced zero output after several minutes (stuck acquiring the shared target-dir lock, same symptom as other concurrent sessions' cargo invocations observed via `ps`); I did not block further on it per policy and rely on the manual verification above plus the final workspace-wide gate the orchestrator runs at the end.

FLAGGED FOR WAVE 4 AUDIT: (1) the missing `.resource_kind(...)` declaration - I added "graph.wires" by analogy to graph.dag/graph.trinity since no prior Wave-1 declaration existed to verify; worth a second look for the right id/dimension convention. (2) PanelTreeBuilder's `item_id(kind, id)` format is a strict 3-part "{namespace}.{kind}.{id}" join; the catalogue panel's original ids were 4-part ("{namespace}.{section}.{index}.{kindId}") - I preserved that exactly by passing `format!("{index}.{kind_id}")` as the `id` argument, which works but is a slightly awkward fit for the builder's intended 2-level shape - flagging in case the SDK gains a variadic/nested item_id helper later.
